title: Nobody's bow
prose: There is a bow leaning against the lean-to that none of them claims. It was there when they made camp, they say, and the time before, in a different place. One of them thinks it follows them. Another says that is a story for children, and moves it further from the fire.

choices.label: Look at the bow
choices.line: It is good work and old work, the string new. By morning it is back by the fire, and nobody admits to moving it.

choices.label: Leave it be
choices.line: You leave it where it leans. You sleep well, and dream of nothing in particular.

notes: A fireside story for a night slept beside a camp of adventurers (Roads and Hands, phase 5). Shared by every map, as the owner's four camp kinds are. Drafted for the owner to rewrite or approve.
